title: TAS — AIQG Cost Destruction (Payload Reduction)
description: Plan #7 payload-reduction: realized active savings, projected-vs-measured, reduction-mode mix, and the Efficacy/Assurance safety view on reduced traffic. Loki-backed (reduction fields are promoted onto the aiqg response event).

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant id
list.description: Filter by tenant_id (regex). Empty = all tenants.

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.description: Fixed vendor enum (Loki can't enumerate parsed fields).

panels.title: Realized active savings (range)
panels.description: Measured USD reclaimed by applied (active) payload reduction over the window.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode="active" | unwrap actual_direct_payload_reduction_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Projected avoidable (combined, range)
panels.description: Always-on heuristic estimate of what payload reduction could save over the window.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | unwrap projected_reduction_combined_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Active share of reduced traffic
panels.description: Fraction of extractor-touched requests that were APPLIED (active) vs measured-only (shadow) — the ramp progress.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode="active" [$__interval])) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode=~"active|shadow" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Projected vs measured savings (USD / interval)
panels.description: Calibration: heuristic projection (all traffic) vs measured reduction (active + shadow).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | unwrap projected_reduction_combined_usd [$__interval]))

sum(sum_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode=~"active|shadow" | unwrap actual_direct_payload_reduction_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Reduction mode mix (req/s)
panels.description: Traffic by reduction_mode — projected (heuristic only), shadow (measured), active (applied).

targets.expr: sum by (reduction_mode) (rate({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode=~"active|shadow|projected" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Efficacy — reduced (active) vs baseline
panels.description: CLEAR Efficacy on applied-reduction traffic vs the rest. A widening gap below baseline is the signal the auto-rollback worker trips on.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode="active" | unwrap clear_efficacy [$__interval]))
avg(avg_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode!="active" | unwrap clear_efficacy [$__interval]))

panels.title: Assurance — reduced (active) vs baseline
panels.description: CLEAR Assurance on applied-reduction traffic vs the rest — the second quality safety gate.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode="active" | unwrap clear_assurance [$__interval]))
avg(avg_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | reduction_mode!="active" | unwrap clear_assurance [$__interval]))

panels.title: Context efficiency ratio (avg)
panels.description: Share of input context the model actually used — lower = more droppable bloat.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | vendor=~"$vendor" | unwrap context_efficiency_ratio [$__interval]))
